notes.title: Monthly Work Report 20250728
notes.content:
[p]Hi everyone, I'm Neo~ [/p][p][/p][p]This is the monthly work report. [/p][p][/p][p]I'll introduce our work content over the past month. [/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]First, we completed the seaside restaurant and its supporting supply chain.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101618/50f609e14e98107435ba839fee02a8242c44951a.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101618/97ca8d48697dffe546a9b42d4d5e73e582f566ff.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]

Below is an introduction to the progress of the Community System.
After the official community update, a prompt box will appear each time you open the game, asking players if they want to switch to the new community system. Of course, the old system will also be fully preserved, depending on the player's choice.
After choosing to switch to the new community system, materials will be refunded based on the number and level of all houses already built.
And players need to go to the new community map scene to build new houses for homeless villagers.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101618/11a498edb26dbde86859c6b420708cae1e6ee488.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]
In the new community, you can easily select any house to change its position, choose your preferred layout, and view its detailed information and villager status.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101618/74a5de5e5fc917a415127766a9545252e624ef4f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]There are 4 functional buildings in the community that affect villager houses within their range: the Community Activity Center, the Small Clinic, the School, and the Community Canteen.[/p][p]The Community Activity Center provides Satisfaction to villagers within its range.[/p][p]The Small Clinic can treat and prevent illness for villagers within its range.[/p][p]The School has a chance to increase the Ability Value of villagers within its range and a low chance to remove Negative Traits from villagers within its range. (Judged once daily)[/p][p]The Community Canteen effectively reduces the chance of Food Poisoning for villagers within its range and has a chance to reduce the Food Consumption of villagers within its range. (Achieved through the Traits of villagers working there)[/p][p]These four buildings require four new types of villager occupations: Teacher, Doctor, Community Administrator, and Canteen Staff.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101618/f3998c860bb40ec5559dcb46aa93090a1c5ea397.png"][/img](The Salesperson here is for temporary testing; in the official update, it will be the Teacher profession working in the School)[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Villagers will be affected by many new factors from different sources, which will calculate their Satisfaction and Work Efficiency.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101618/ee746eb0b6b5b0f212ac03889f8f76f22bacad8f.png"][/img][/p][p]Players need to consider how to reasonably layout the community to provide a better living environment for the villagers.[/p][p]Players need to build Small Clinics to prevent villagers from getting sick and build Community Canteens to prevent villagers from food poisoning.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101618/2b6d0a04eebac5eaead433c6e3e3d69c6213d1ae.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]That's all for this work report. The community system overhaul still needs time to complete; it's indeed a significant amount of work, requiring rewriting many interfaces. Thank you for your support and patience.[/p][p][/p][p]See you in the next work report~[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Method for Players to Upload Custom Language Mod Packs
notes.content:
How to Upload a Language Pack Mod:


First, download the Language Pack Mod from the Steam Workshop.
The Mod's directory is located in the Steam installation directory => ~:\SteamLibrary\steamapps\workshop\content\3085890.

In the game installation directory ~/LandOfIdyllicBeauty_Data/SteamWorkshopContent, create a new folder named Language.

(If the SteamWorkshopContent folder or "Language" folder does not exist, create them manually.)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101618/4b87306d7f901c113c986f0566c91051a126772c.png[/img]
Copy the files from the Language Mod you just downloaded into the Language folder, as shown in the image above.


Modify the configuration data in the ModConfig.json file to change the name, description, etc., of the language pack to be uploaded.
(You can also manually modify these on the Steam Workshop after successful upload, even if you don’t modify them now.)
Note: Do not modify the line ModType": "language".


Edit the text entries in the corresponding JSON file to create your own Language Pack Mod.

Important Note: The preview image file preview": "Preview.png" must not exceed 1MB in size, preferably under 900KB. Exceeding this size will cause the Mod upload to fail.


Once all preparations are complete, launch the game and click Upload Mod in the lower-left corner of the initial screen to upload the Mod.

The functions of subscribing to and uploading multilingual packs in the Steam Workshop have been updated. The first - phase sample template is in Spanish, and other languages will be updated in sequence. (For the specific uploading tutorial, please check the Steam Workshop. If you have any questions or find any bugs, please let me know through the discussion forum or other means, and I will fix them immediately.)

Please note that I have modified the loading method of the Portrait Mod. If the Portrait Mod fails to load properly after updating the game, please try restarting Steam to update the Mod in the Steam Workshop.

The bug that caused the left joystick of the controller to stop working has been fixed.

Various bugs that occurred when clicking the buttons frequently during construction have been fixed.

The display effect of the switch function button in the Manual => Building Menu has been modified, and the quantity display has been improved.

The background music will play until 24:00 at night.

A fade - out effect has been added when the background music disappears.

Some text errors have been corrected.

In the game installation directory "~/LandOfIdyllicBeauty_Data/SteamWorkshopContent", create a new folder named "Portraits". (If there is no SteamWorkshopContent folder and "Portraits" folder, please create them manually.)

Then copy the files in the Mod you just downloaded into the Portraits folder. At this time, there should be several character png images and a json file for setting parameters (Portraits_Config.json) in the Portraits folder.

The simplest way to create a character art mod is to directly replace the PNG image of the corresponding character, and there is no need to modify the name. In this case, there is no need to modify the json setting file. (Of course, players can also customize the image name, and please manually replace it in the json file.)

If the player only wants to replace part of the character art, then you need to manually delete the entries you don't need and keep the entries you need. For example, if the player only wants to upload the character art of BeiGuo and YingChun, then the Json file is like this:
{
    "mod_title": "Mod name",
    "mod_description": "mod description",
    "content_folder": "Portraits",
	"preview": "Preview_Portrait.png",
    "visibility": "Public",
    "portraits": [
        {
            "ID_Villager": 2,
            "portrait_Normal": "BeiGuo_Portrait.png",
            "portrait_Smile": "BeiGuo_Portrait.png",
            "portrait_Sad": "BeiGuo_Portrait.png"
        },
        {
            "ID_Villager": 3,
            "portrait_Normal": "YinChun_Portrait.png",
            "portrait_Smile": "YinChun_Portrait.png",
            "portrait_Sad": "YinChun_Portrait.png"
        }
    ]
}

[b]In addition, there is a very important point. The file size of the preview image Preview_Portrait of the uploaded file should not exceed 1m, and it is best to keep it below 900kb. If it exceeds this size, the mod upload will fail.[/b]

After preparation, enter the game and click "Upload Mod" in the lower left corner of the initial entry interface to upload the Mod.

Fish - related cuisine
Ways to obtain the complete fish atlas
Quests from the seaside fishermen
Aquarium
Seaside salt - making field

notes.content:
Hello everyone, I’m Neo~

Here is the monthly work report.

I’ll introduce the work we’ve done in the past month.

First, here are the optimizations and new features already implemented in the game:

I have adjusted the loading method for the buildings and map tiles in the Back Mountain area, which improves performance when there are many buildings in that region.

I’ve redesigned the UI background images for the manual and backpack panels, as well as the backpack expansion animation. Compared to the previous version, the new version is simpler and clearer, avoiding blurriness in dim or nighttime scenes.

Many players feel lost when starting the game, not knowing how to play. Therefore, I added a beginner quest guide system to help players quickly get into the game. I’ll add more quest flows in the future, especially after the beach version goes live.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101618/b970e4ddb05dc23c7609908469efbb831976792d.png[/img]


I’ve also added a villager task commission system. Each villager will issue unique tasks, and completing these tasks will reward you with friendship points, items, and coins.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101618/9c27c4f865886163bf2b52af67b08ab3c56535ca.png[/img]


Several players commented in the discussion area about wanting to load different save files or create new save slots to try different playstyles. I spent a lot of time reconstructing the game’s underlying data loading system to implement save and load functionality.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101618/f54bee34a772d86714efec48fc552587c0d6953c.png[/img]


Additionally, some other bug fixes and optimizations have been made. For details, please check the Steam game update announcements.

Now, here’s what we’re currently working on but hasn’t been implemented in the game yet:

We’ve spent a significant amount of time designing the seaside area, including its art design and various interactions on the map.

We have completed most of the seaside map, as well as the aquarium and pier.

If time permits, a saltworks area, animations for the saltworks, and villagers working there.
Due to the uncertainty of completing all the initial fishing-related collectible content, fish tank animations, and a large number of UI elements, I’m unsure if everything can be done by the end of January.

If we’re unable to finish on time, I apologize in advance to players who are eagerly waiting. The workload is indeed massive, and there are only two of us working on it. I hope we can complete the initial seaside content and fishing features in time.

Thank you for your support! See you at the end of January~

With relentless effort and the help of a lot of coffee, in the past 30 days I have completed the following:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101618/40f059ae238556bda180094bfdca1cd7bf33204e.png[/img]

New villager gift dialogues.
Some convenient new features, such as the ability to move buildings in the shopping district, bulk harvesting of fruit trees, quick recipe selection in the research panel, and unlocking dialogues for villagers’ favorite items, etc.
Numerous optimizations and bug fixes.


The most important achievement is that I have partially implemented controller support by upgrading the engine and switching to a new input system. I say "partially" because there are still some panels that do not fully support controller input, such as the storage and cooking panels (though they can be interacted with via the virtual mouse). For these panels that do not yet support full input, I will continue to optimize them in the future, and the existing parts will be adjusted based on player feedback.

I must say, controller support turned out to be much more complex than I anticipated. Issues like the incompatibility between PS controllers and Xbox controllers (for example, the Xbox controller’s D-pad up/down/left/right buttons are the PS controller's left/right buttons and joystick up/down), along with many interaction mode resets, consumed a lot of time as I learned and adjusted the controller input functions. But I finally achieved a breakthrough from 0 to 1. Honestly, there was a moment when I thought about abandoning controller support.

Next, I will shift my focus to developing the seaside area. The seaside will have its own unique supply chain, as well as profit-generating buildings like a seafood restaurant. Buildings will be added to produce currently unavailable products like seafood and sea salt. There will also be fishing and aquarium-related gameplay.

The development of the seaside version will take a considerable amount of time, comparable to developing an entirely new game. During the development process, I will continue to optimize game content and further improve the controller input functionality for the panels.

Thank you all for your support!

notes.title: Report on the Work Plan for the Next 30 Days
notes.content:
In the three days since the game's EA release, I have received a lot of feedback and suggestions from players. The two main issues are:

The game does not support controllers.
The dialogue in the game cannot be manually controlled, and some players find the automatic display speed too fast, while others find it too slow.
To address these issues, I will prioritize adding controller support. I need to rework the interaction methods for all UI panels, so it will take some time to implement and modify. As for the dialogue issue, I plan to resolve it by changing the dialogues to manual control. Players will be able to control the dialogue progression by pressing the spacebar or clicking anywhere with the left mouse button. This approach should resolve the issues mentioned by players, but it will also take some time, as I need to rewrite the code for all dialogue sections in the game's story.

I aim to resolve these two issues within the next 30 days. At the same time, I will continue to add new content to the game, such as cacao trees and coffee trees, along with the corresponding supply chain recipes, more gameplay guides, and two unique festivals—'Mid-Autumn Festival' and 'Dragon Boat Festival.'

Thank you for your support and understanding. This is my first time developing a game, and I lack experience in certain areas. If you have any questions, please feel free to contact me via the Steam discussions or other means. Thank you!
